title: The key with no gate
body: The road map is folded to the exit road. The key tag says returned, although the envelope tucked under it is stamped hold at gate. A coffee ring covers the line for who collected it.
rival_reading: A field worker could have returned a key while a farm access instruction was being changed; a damaged handoff does not prove an evacuation failed.
gloss: A returned access key remains with an instruction that still holds it at a gate.

title: Water for an unnamed round
body: The bottle is marked field, but the bucket carries a second, cleaner measurement. A torn lunch list says: water first, names later. The return slip has a box for containers and none for workers.
rival_reading: Emergency staff could have gathered water during a road response and logged containers before identifying everyone; the paperwork is also compatible with a failed evacuation.
gloss: Two water measures and a nameless return slip keep the field work visible while the people remain unlisted.
